Ka igkarangeb ne sulat ni Pablu te

The second letter by Paul to

Matig-Kurintu

The (ones) from_Kurintu

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka igkarangeb ne sulat ni Pablu te Matig-Kurintu, diye din sulata te Masidunya. Insulat din seini te timpu ne kene amana ne meupiya ka rilasyun dan te migmalintutuu diye te Kurintu.

The second letter by Paul (MS Pablu) to The (ones) from_Kurintu, he wrote from Masidunya. He wrote this at a time when his relationship with the believers in Kurintu wasn't very good.

Kayi te an-anayan ne baad te seini ne baseen, migpangguhud si Pablu meyitenged te rilasyun dan te migmalintutuu diye te Kurintu. Impangguhud din ka pegkasasew rin meyitenged te pegpeyilew wey pegsupak kandin te migmalintutuu. Ne impangguhud din man-e ka kahale din ne ka seeye ne pegkabelu din, nakapamehas te peg-inniyug te migmalintutuu te sale dan wey nekeg-uli ka meupiya ne geyinawa ran. Ne mighangyu sikandin te migmalintutuu ne egpabulus ne egpangangey te dasag dan ne igbulig te migmalintutuu ne egkaayu-ayu diye te Hirusalim.

Here in the first part of this document, Paul told about his relationship to the believers there in Kurintu. He told his concern about the believers shaming and disobeying him. And he also told of his joy that that anger of his, (it) bore_fruit in the believers turning_from their sin(s) and restoring_[reciprocally] their good relationship (LIT breath). And he requested the believers to continue to collect their gift as a help for the poor believers in Hirusalim (MS Hirusalim).

Te katammanan ne hep-at ne kapitulu, impangabangan ni Pablu ka pegkaapustulis din te seeye se mig-angken ne sikandan de ka malehet ne apustulis. Sikandan seeye se migbayung ki Pablu ne kene kun ne malehet ne apustulis.

In the final four chapters, Paul defended his apostleship to those who claimed that only they were the true apostle(s). They were those who accused Paul of not (hearsay) being a true apostle.

11 [xr]Sikeddiey si Pablu ka migpeuyan te seini ne sulat duma te suled ta ne si Timutiyu. Apustulis a ni Kristu Hisus pinaahi te pegbuut te Manama.

11 [xr]It's me Paul who sent this letter along_with our(incl) friend/cousin Timothy (MS Timutiyu). I (am) an apostle of Christ Jesus (MS Kristu Hisus) by_means_of the will of God (MS Manama).

Egpangemusta key kaniyu te migmalintutuu te Manama due te Kurintu duma te langun ne keet-etawan din diye te intiru ne Akaya.

We(excl) greet you(pl) believers in God there in Kurintu along_with all his people there in entire Akaya.

2 Ka keyid-u wey keupianan ne egpuun te Manama ne Amey ta wey te Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, egkaangken niyu.

2 The mercy and peace/well-being from God our(incl) Father and the Lord Hisu Kristu, be received by you(pl).

Ka pegpasalamat ni Pablu te Manama

The thanking of God by Paul

3 Egdayanen ta ka Manama ne Amey te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu. Hiid-uwen sikandin ne Amey, wey Manama ne talagliwang te langun ne egkeyirapan. 4 Egliwangen ki nikandin te langun ne igkeyirapi ta, su eyew egpakaliwang ki degma te seeye se due igkeyirapi ne minsan nekey. Egpakaliwang ki kandan iling te pegliwang ne narawat ta puun te Manama. 5 Masalig ka in-antus ta ne iling te in-antus ni Kristu, sikan naa, masalig degma ka narawat ta ne pegliwang pinaahi ki Kristu. 6 Emun ke egkeyirapan key, pegliwang naa sika kaniyu wey para te kaluwasan niyu. Ne iling naan ded degma, emun ke egkaliwang key, egpakaliwang key degma kaniyu, su eyew kene kew egkapelaan ne eg-antus te keyirapan ne iling te in-antus ney. 7 Dakel ka pegsalig ney kaniyu. Nakataha key ne taheed te eg-antus kew iling kanami, egliwangen kew red degma te Manama iling kanami.

3 We(incl) praise God the Father of our(incl) Lord Jesus Christ. He is a compassionate Father, and the God who is the comforter for all who have_difficulties. 4 We(incl) are comforted by him in/through all of our(incl) difficulties, so_that we(incl) can_comfort those who have whatever difficulties. We(incl) can_comfort them like the comforting that we(incl) received from God. 5 We(incl) suffered much like the suffering of Christ, so then, we(incl) also received much comforting by_means of Christ. 6 If/When we(excl) suffer difficulty, that's comforting for you(pl) and for you(pl) salvation. And just like that also, if/when we(excl) are comforted, we(excl) can also comfort you(pl), so_that you(pl) will_ not _be_impatient to endure/suffer difficulties like we(excl) endured/suffered. 7 Our(excl) trusting of you(pl) is great. We(excl) know that while you(pl) suffer/endure like us(excl), you(pl) will_ also just _be_comforted by God like us(excl.)

8 [xr]Me suled, egkeupian key ne egkanengnengan niyu ka nabaybayaan ney ne keyirapan diye te prubinsya te Asya. Pepeiti naan de iya seeye se nabayaan ney su hendue te kene ney e egkeelehan wey hendue te igpatey ney en iya. 9 Ka malehet, nangenen ney ne seinid en iya ka katammanan ney. Piru neyitabu bes seeye eyew kene key egsalig te pegkeetew ney, ke kene, te Manama re ne iyan eg-uyag te me minatey. 10 Inluwas key iya nikandin puun te makaalat-halat ne keyirapan, wey egluwasen key red man-e nikandin te egginguma pad ne keyirapan. Sikandin de ka egkapallateng ney ne egpabulus ne egluwas man-e kanami, 11 ne bulihi key degma nikaniyu te eg-ampu. Ne emun ke eggimuwen niyu sika, egtabaken te Manama ka me peg-ampu niyu wey egbulihan key nikandin, wey masalig ka egpasalamat kandin tenged kanami.

8 [xr]Friends/Cousins, we(excl) want you(pl) to know what_ difficulty(s) we(excl) _went_through there in the province of Asya. That which_ we(excl) _went_through was indeed bitter because it was like we(excl) really couldn't endure (it) and like (it) was going to kill us(excl). 9 The truth is, we(excl) thought that this was really our(excl) end. But amazingly that happened so_that we(excl) won't trust ourselves(excl), but rather, in God alone who brings_to_life the dead. 10 We(excl) were_saved by him from terrifying difficulty(s), and we(excl) will_be_saved by him from the still coming difficulty(s). He alone is the (one) we(excl) hope_for who will_continue to save us(excl) again, 11 so help(pl) us(excl) also by praying. And if you(pl) do that, your(pl) prayers will_be_answered by God and we(excl) will_be_helped by him, and many will_thank him concerning us(excl).

Nabalbalawan ka planu ni Pablu

The plan of Paul is changed

12 Due seini se igpakapeggasal ney, wey nakataha key ne malehet iya seini: ka pegbebatasan ney diye te me etew, matareng key iya wey malinis ka tuyu ney diye te tangkaan te Manama, labi en iya due te kaniyu. Neyimu ney sika pinaahi te bulig wey keyid-u te Manama, kene ne pinaahi te kanami ne katuenan. 13 Su kene key egsulat kaniyu te kene niyu egkabasa wey egkasabut. Eg-iman-iman a ne egginguma red ka timpu ne egkasabut-sabut key red iya nikaniyu, 14 minsan kene kew bayew egpakasabut kuntee, su eyew te peglibed te Magbebaye ne si Hisus, egpakapeggasal kew red kanami iling te pegpeggasal ney kaniyu.

12 There_is this that we(excl) can_boast_about, and we(excl) know that this is true: our(excl) custom/behavior towards the people, we(excl) are indeed righteous and not liar(s), especially towards you(pl) due to the help of God. We(excl) did that by_means_of the help and mercy of God, not by_means_of our(excl)(emph) skill/knowledge. 13 Because we(excl) won't write to you(pl) what you(pl) won't read and understand. I hope that the time will_come that we(excl) will_be_indeed well_understood by you(pl), 14 even_though you(pl) can't really understand now, so_that at the returning of the Lord Jesus, you(pl) will_be_able_to_boast about us(excl) like our(excl) boasting about you(pl).

15 Ne tenged su nakanengneng a ne nakasabut kew kayi, sikan naa ka nakaplanu a ne eggun-aan ku perem sikaniyu egpanumbalayi eyew kararuwa kew egkapanalangini. 16 [xr]Migplanu a ne egpanumbaley kaniyu te peggendiye ku te Masidunya wey egtulan ded man-e te peglibed kud e eyew igpakapaligkat a nikaniyu peendiye te Hudiya. 17 Ne puun su ware natuman sika, kahiyen niyu buwa ne egkaalin-halin ka suman-suman ku? Wey ke iling e naa ne egplanu te me etew kayi te kalibutan ne mahaan eg-uya-uya piru egkene-kene bes perem? 18 Ne puun su matinumanen ka Manama, egkasalihan degma ka inlalag ney kaniyu, su emun ke eg-uya-uya key, uya naan iya. 19 [xr]Su si Hisu Kristu, ne Anak te Manama, ka inwali ney engki Timutiyu wey Silas diye te kaniyu, kene sikandin eg-uya-uya ke egkene-kene, su ka langun ne eglalahen din, egtumanen din iya. 20 Su pinaahi ki Kristu, natuman ka langun ne saad te Manama. Ne sika ka egpuunan ne pinaahi ki Kristu, egpakakahi ki te malehet iya, eyew egkarayan ka Manama. 21 Sika ne Manama ka miglig-en kanta due ki Kristu wey sikandin ka mig-alam kanta. 22 Intahuan ki degma nikandin te palinneu ne kandin kid en iya, ne iyan din impeugpe kayi te pusung ta ka Panisingan din eyew egpakataha ki ne egtumanen din iya ka langun ne insaad din.

15 And because I know that you(pl) understand this, that's why I planned to first visit you(pl) so_that you(pl) would_be_blessed twice. 16 [xr]I planned to visit you(pl) when I went to Masidunya and to call_in also again on my returning so_that you(pl) can send_ me _off going_there to Judea. 17 And because that wasn't fulfilled, maybe you(pl) thought that my mind kept_changing? Or if I planned like the people here in the world who quickly say_yes_yes but really want to say_no_no? 18 And since God is faithful, what we(excl) say to you(pl) can also be_trusted, because if we(excl) say_yes_yes, it means yes indeed. 19 [xr]Because Jesus Christ, the Child of God, is who Timothy and Silas and I have preached there to you(pl), he doesn't say_yes_yes if it's no_no, because all that_ he _says, he really fulfills. 20 Because by_means_of Christ, all of the promises of God were fulfilled. And that's the reason that by means of Christ, we(incl) can_say true indeed, so_that God will_be_praised. 21 That is the God who strengthens us(incl) in Christ and he is the (one who) chose us(incl). 22 He also put_ a sign _in us(incl) that we(incl) are really his, and that he caused_ his Spirit _to_live here in our(incl) heart(s) so_that we(incl) will_know that he indeed fulfills all that he promised.

23 Ka Manama ka talagpamalehet ku ne malehet ka eglalahen ku. Iyan egpuunan ne wara a miggendue te Kurintu su eyew kena a egpakapasakit kaniyu. 24 Ne kene ne iyan ku igpasabut due ne menu egmanduan ney e ka pegpalintutuu niyu, ke kene, miggimu key duma kaniyu su eyew perem egkahale kew, su nakataha key e ne malig-en e ka pegpalintutuu niyu.

23 God is my witness that what_ I _say is true. The reason that I didn't go to Kurintu so_that I wouldn't be_able_to_hurt you(pl). 24 And I don't mean by that that your(pl) believing is commanded by us(excl), but rather, we(excl) worked along_with you(pl) so_that you(pl) would hopefully be happy, because we(excl) know that your(pl) faith/believing is already strong.

21 Sikan naa ka nakaplanu a ne kena a eglibed egpanumbaley due te kaniyu su kema ke egpakapasakit e red man-e kaniyu iling te peggenduen ku dengan. 2 Su emun ke egkapasakitan ku pad sikaniyu, hentew naan e ka egpakapahale keddi? Warad e lein, gawas iya kaniyu te napasakitan ku. 3 Sika ka egpuunan ne insulatan ku sikaniyu te iling ded te insulat ku dengan, su eyew te peggenduen ku, kena a egkasakitan te seeye se egpakapahale perem keddi. Su nakataha a ne emun ke egkahala a, egkahale kew degma langun. 4 Pegsulat ku dengan kaniyu, amana ne masakit ka geyinawa ku wey migsinehew a tenged te kalaggew ku. Kene ne iyan ku tuyu ka pegpasakit kaniyu, ke kene, igkeupii ku re perem ne egpakataha kew ne amana ku dakeli sikaniyu te geyinawa.

21 That's why I planned that I won't visit you(pl) again because what if I again cause_ you(pl) _pain like my going_there before. 2 Because if I still cause(invol)_ you(pl) _to_be_hurt, who then is left to cause_ me _to_be_happy? There's_no (one) else, except you(pl) indeed that I caused(invol)_to_be_hurt. 3 That's the reason that I wrote to you(pl) like what_ I _wrote before, so_that at my going_there, I won't be hurt by those who should make_ me _happy. Because I know that if I am happy, you(pl) all will_ also _be_happy. 4 In my writing to you(pl) before, I was very disturbed (LIT my breath was very sore) and I cried due to my sorrow. It's not my purpose to cause_ you(pl) _to_hurt, but rather, I [wishfully] wanted you(pl) to know that I greatly love you(pl).

Ka pegpasaylu te nakasale

Forgiveness of sinner(s)

5 Na, meyitenged te seeye se nakapasakit, kene ne sikeddi ka impasakitan din, su sikaniyu, piru kene ne sikaniyu langun. Egkahiyen ku ne kene ne sikaniyu langun, su egkeepes a ne egpakalalag a te gahag. 6 Eleg de iya ka pegsapad kandin te kasuluhan kaniyu. 7 Purisu, pasayluwa niyud e sikandin wey liwanga niyud e, su kema ke egkeuyan sikandin ke egmangune-kune ka kalaggew rin. 8 Sikan naa, eghangyu a kaniyu ne ipapitew niyu ne miggeyinawaan niyu pad iya sikandin. 9 Sika ka egpuunan ne migsulatan ku sikaniyu dengan, eyew peg-eleg-eleg kaniyu wey eyew egpakataha a ne egtumanen niyu red iya ka langun ne ingkahi ku. 10 Emun ke egpasayluwen niyu sikandin, egpasayluwen kud e degma. Piru ka malehet, ke duen ma keilangan ne egpasayluwen ku, impasaylu kud e sikandin diye te tangkaan ni Kristu tenged kaniyu. 11 Inggimu ku sika su eyew kene ki egkatalu wey egkalimbungan ni Meibulan, su nakataha kid ma te mareet ne planu rin.

5 Now_then, concerning the (one who) has caused_hurt, it's not me that he/she caused_to_hurt, but you(pl), but not you(pl) all. I say not you(pl) all, because I don't like speaking exaggeratedly. 6 The scolding of him/her by most of you(pl) was just correct indeed. 7 Therefore, forgive(pl) him/her and comfort him/her, because what if he/she is carried_off if his/her sadness is severe/intense. 8 So then, I request you(pl) to show(pl) that you(pl) still really love him/her. 9 That's the reason that I wrote to you(pl) before, for testing you(pl) and so_that I would know that you(pl) indeed fulfill all that I said. 10 If/When you(pl) forgive him/her, I will_ also _forgive (him/her). But the truth is, if there_is a need for me to forgive, I've already forgiven him/her in front of Christ because of you(pl). 11 I did that so_that we(incl) won't lose or be cheated by Satan, because we(incl) really know his evil plan.

Ka pegkabantali ni Pablu diye te Truwas

The anxiety of Paul there at Truwas

12 [xr]Pegginguma ku diye te Truwas te pegwali ku te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Kristu, nakita ku ne tapey e andama te Magbebaye ka paahi eyew egpekeyimu a te igpeyimu rin keddiey. 13 Piru nabantalan a su ware ku nakita diye ka suled ta ne si Titu. Purisu migpanaha-taha a kandan diye wey miggendiya ad te Masidunya.

12 [xr]On my arriving there in Truwas for my preaching of the Good Report about Christ, I saw that the Lord had prepared the way in_advance so_that I could do what he caused_ me _to_do. 13 But I was anxious because I didn't see our(incl) friend/cousin Titu there. Therefore I farewelled them there and I went to Masidunya.

Ka kapanaluwan pinaahi ki Kristu

The victory by_means_of Christ

14 Piru salamat te Manama su pinaahi te pegsabeka ta ki Kristu, sikandin ka layun egpangulu kanta te kapanaluwan. Eggamiten ki nikandin eyew te pegpeila ki Kristu te minsan hendei iling te heemuti ne insinsu. 15 Su egpekeiling ki te meemut ne insinsu ne inhalad ni Kristu diye te Manama, ne egkaarek te seeye se egkengalluwas wey minsan seeye se egmekeendiyad te karereetan. 16 Te seeye se egmekeendiye te karereetan, egpekeiling sika te ngareg te minatey ne egpakapatey te etew; piru te seeye se egkengalluwas, egpekeiling sika te peemut ne egbehey te umul. Na, hentew ma ka eleg te iling due ne himu? 17 Su kene key ne iling te kasuluhan ne egpangguhud te lalag te Manama eyew te pegpaneleppi. Piru puun su ka Manama ka migpeuyan kanami, wey sikandin ka migtengteng kanami, leleheti iya mule ka impangguhud ney kaniyu isip me suluhuanen ni Kristu.

14 But thanks to God because by_means_of our(incl) uniting in Christ, he always leads us(incl) to/in victory. We(incl) are used by him in_order for making_ Christ _known everywhere like very_fragrant incense. 15 Because we(incl) are_like fragrant incense that was_offered by Christ to God, that can be smelled by those who are_saved(pl) and even by those who are_going_there to destruction. 16 To those who are_going(pl) to destruction, it's like the smell of a corpse that can_kill a person; but to those who are_saved(pl), it's like fragrance that gives life. Now_then, who is worthy for work like that? 17 Because we(excl) are_ not _like many that story the word of God in_order_for making_money. But because it's God who sent us(excl), and he is (the one) watching us(excl), (what) we(excl) story to you(pl) as servants of Christ is very_true.

Ka iyam ne kasabutan

The new agreement

31 Kema ke egsuman-suman kew ne migpeggasal key e man-e te pegkeetew ney? Kene key ne iling te duma ne keilangan ne eg-uyan te sulat eyew te pegpeila-ila kaniyu. Ne kene degma ne keilangan ne eg-uyan key te sulat ne egpuun kaniyu te pegpeila-ila kanami diye te egkeendiyaan ney. 2 Kene ney ne keilangan sika, su hendue te sikaniyu mismu ka sulat ney te pegpeila-ila ne nasulat kayi te pusung ney,[fn] su eyew egkanengnengan wey egkabasa te langun. 3 [xra][xrb]Klaru ne henduen kew te sulat ni Kristu ne impeuyan pinaahi kanami. Piru kene ne tinta ka inggamit te pegsulat due, ke kene, ka Panisingan te manekal ne Manama. Ne kene ne diye sulata seini te malumpayag ne batu, ke kene, diye te pusung te etew.

31 What if you(pl) think that we(excl) are boasting again about ourselves(excl)? We(excl) are_ not _like others that need to take a letter in_order for introducing (themselves) to you(pl). And it's also not necessary that we(excl) take a letter from you(pl) for introducing ourselves(excl) there where_ we(excl) _are_going. 2 We(excl) don't need that, because it's as if you(pl) yourselves are our(excl) letter for introducing that was_written here on our(excl)[fn] heart(s), so_that it can_be_known and can_be_read by all. 3 [xra][xrb]It's clear that you(pl) are_like the letter of Christ that was_sent by_means_of us(excl). But it wasn't ink that was used for writing that, but rather, the Spirit of the strong/living God. And this wasn't written on flat rock, but rather, on the heart(s) of a person/people.

4 Egpakalalag key te iling due tenged su amana key migsalig te Manama pinaahi ki Kristu. 5 Piru kene key egpakaangken ne egpekeyimu key te iling due puun te katuenan ney, su ka katuenan ney, diye de egpuun te Manama. 6 [xr]Sikandin ka migbehey kanami te katuenan ne egpanulu meyitenged te iyam ne kasabutan. Ka seini ne kasabutan, kene ne sinulat ne balaud, ke kene, pinaahi mule seini te Panisingan te Manama. Su ka sinulat ne balaud, eg-uyan te kamatayen, piru ka Panisingan, egbehey mule te umul ne ware egtamanan.

4 We(excl) can talk like that because we(excl) greatly trust God through Christ. 5 But we(excl) can't accept that we(excl) are able_to_do like that from our(excl) knowledge/skill(s), because our(excl) knowledge/skill(s), are just from God. 6 [xr]He (is) the (one who) gave us(excl) skill/knowledge to teach about the new agreement. This agreement, is not a written law, but rather, by_means_of the Spirit of God. Because the written law, brings death, but the Spirit, on_the_contrary gives life without ending.

7 [xr]Te pegbehey te Manama ki Muwisis te Balaud ne insulat diye te malumpayag ne batu, kene egpakamemetmet ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te ulaula ni Muwisis su amana ne masil-ew, minsan egkapahan-ganaran e egkaawe ka kasil-ew. Ne emun ke iling ma rue kasil-ew ka impakita te Manama te pegbehey rin te Balaud ne eg-uyan te kamatayen, 8 labew en iya ka katelesan ne impakita rin te pegbehey rin te Panisingan din! 9 Su ke impakita te Manama ka kasil-ew te katelesan din te pegbehey rin te Balaud ne egpekewukum, labew en iya ne igpakita rin ka katelesan din ke egmatarengen din e ka me etew. 10 Ka malehet, ka kasil-ew te katelesan te Balaud dengan, ware de nekegmenu ke igpeiling ta te kuntee ne kasil-ew te katelesan te seini se iyam ne kasabutan. 11 Su emun ke due katelesan te sika se Balaud ne egkaawe ded, iyan naan pa kene ne labew ka katelesan te sika se kasabutan ne kenad iya egkaawe.

7 [xr]At the giving of the law to Moses by God that was_written on flat rock, the descendants of Israil couldn't stare at the face of Moses because it greatly shone, even_though the shine slowly disappeared. And if the shine that was shown by God at the giving of the Law that brings death was like that, 8 the splendor that was_given by him at his giving of his Spirit was indeed greater! 9 Because if God showed the shine of his splendor at his giving of the Law that is able_to_judge, he indeed greatly shows his splendor when he makes_ the people _righteous. 10 The truth is, the shine of the splendor of the Law before, it's nothing if we(excl) compare it with the current shine of the splendor of this new agreement. 11 Because if there_was splendor of that Law that just disappears, how much more greater is the splendor of that agreement that won't indeed disappear.

12 Purisu, puun su egpallateng key ne ka iyam ne kasabutan kene egkaawe, kene key en iya egkaaldek ka egwali. 13 [xr]Kene key ne iling ki Muwisis ne migbubunbun te ulaula rin eyew kene egkakita te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka kasil-ew te ulaula rin ne egkapahan-ganaran bes e egkaawe. 14 Piru makehal ka me ulu ran, su minsan kuntee, emun ke egbaseen dan e ka tapey ne kasabutan, hendue te egbunbunan ka me suman-suman dan su eyew kene sikandan egpakasabut te kamalehetan. Egkaawe de ka sika ne bunbun pinaahi te pegpalintutuu ki Kristu. 15 Uya iya, minsan kuntee, emun ke egbaseen dan ka sinulat ni Muwisis, hendue te egbunbunan ded ka me suman-suman dan. 16 [xr]Piru ke egparani e ka etew diye te Magbebaye, egkaawe e ka nakabunbun te suman-suman din. 17 Na, ka egkahiyen kayi ne Magbebaye, sika se Panisingan te Magbebaye. Ne emun ke iyan mig-ugpe due te etew ka Panisingan te Magbebaye, duen naan e kaligwangan din. 18 Ne sikanta langun se warad bunbun te ulaula, egpekeiling ki te alungan ne egkakitaan te katelesan te Magbebaye. Ne ka sika ne katelesan, diye egpuun te Magbebaye ne sika se Panisingan te Manama. Sikandin ka egpabulus ne egbalew-balew kanta taman te egpekeiling kid en iya kandin.

12 Therefore, since we(excl) hope_(positively) that the new agreement won't disappear, we(excl) are not indeed afraid to preach. 13 [xr]We(excl) are_ not _like Moses who covered his face so_that the descendants of Israil couldn't see the shine of his face that was slowly disappearing. 14 But their heads were hard, because even now, if/when the old agreement is read by them, it's as if their thinking is covered so_that they can't understand the truth. That cover can_be_removed only by_means_of believing in Christ. 15 Yes indeed, even now, if/when they read what_ Moses _wrote, it's as if their thinking is just covered. 16 [xr]But if a person approaches the Lord, what_covered his thinking disappears. 17 Now_then, the Lord that is spoken_of here, is that Spirit of the Lord. And if it is the Spirit of the Lord that lives in a person, he/she has freedom. 18 And we(incl) all who have nothing covering (our) face(s), we(incl) are_like a mirror where the splendor of the Lord can_be_seen. And that splendor, comes from the Lord who is that Spirit of God. He (is) the (one who) continues to change us(incl) until we(incl) are really like him.

Ka karatuan ne intahu te kuren ne inggimu puun te tane

The wealth put in a pot made from dirt

41 Purisu, puun su ka Manama ka migbehey kanami te seini ne himu pinaahi te keyid-u rin, ware key naawei te kabagget. 2 Insawile ney e ka mekeyilew-hilew ne himu ne eggimuwen te heles de. Ware key migpanlimbung te minsan hentew wey ware ney balbalawi ka lalag te Manama, ke kene, migpangguhud key te kamalehetan diye te tangkaan te Manama. Ne migpakannekalan ney ne ware igkarew-ey kanami te langun ne etew. 3 Ne minsan ke neeles diye te duma ka kamalehetan meyitenged te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne inwali ney, piru diye de neeles sika te me etew ne egpekeendiye te karereetan. 4 Kene sikandan egpalintutuu, tenged su imbunbunan ni Meibulan[fn] ka suman-suman dan eyew kene sikandan egpakakita te kalayag te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged te katelesan ni Kristu. Ne si Kristu ka iling en iya te Manama. 5 Ne kene ne meyitenged te pegkeetew ney ka inwali ney, ke kene, meyitenged ki Hisu Kristu ne Magbebaye. Ne sikanami, me suluhuanen key re nikaniyu tenged ki Hisus. 6 [xr]Su ka Manama ne migkahi, “Eglayag diye te karusileman ka kalayag,” sikan ded ne Manama ka migbehey te kalayag kayi te me suman-suman ta eyew egkabehayan te kalayag ka duma pinaahi te peg-ila te katelesan din ne impakita rin pinaahi ki Kristu.

41 Therefore, since God gave us(incl) this work by_means_of his mercy, we(excl) haven't been bereft of encouragement. 2 We(excl) rejected (LIT threw_away) the shameful activities done in secret. We(excl) don't cheat(pl) anybody and we(excl) don't change the word of God, but rather, we(excl) tell the truth in front of God. And we(excl) strove that there would_be nothing that all the people could scold (us) for. 3 And even if the truth about the Good Report which we(excl) preach is hidden from other(s), but it's just hidden from those people who are_going to destruction. 4 They don't believe, because Satan[fn] covered their thinking so_that they can't see the light of the Good Report about the splendor of Christ. And Christ indeed is like God. 5 And we(excl) don't preach about our(excl) (own) lives, but rather, about Jesus Christ the Lord. And we(excl), we(excl) are just your(pl) servants due to Jesus. 6 [xr]Because the God who said, “The light will_shine in the darkness,” that's the God who gave the light here in our(incl) thinking so_that others will_be_given the light by_means of knowing his splendor that he revealed by_means of Christ.

7 Piru sikanami, egpekeiling key re te kuren ne inggimu puun te tane ne intahuan te mahal ne karatuan ne sika se pegpangguhud te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, eyew egkakita te me etew ne ka amana ne dakel ne geem ne nakatahu kayi te mahuye ne lawa ney, kene ne kanami ne geem, ke kene, kandin te Manama. 8 Egkeyirapan key te minsan nekey ne paahi, piru kene key red egkatalu. Egkabenga-benga key, piru kene key red eg-engked. 9 Imbaybayaran key, piru ware key red engkeri te Manama; amana key pasakiti, piru ware key red himatayi. 10 Layun key igsalerep te kamatayen ne iling te kamatayen ni Hisus, eyew egkakita kayi te lawa ney ka umul ne imbehey ni Hisus. 11 Ne taheed te neuyag key pad, layun key iya egpakasalerep te kamatayen tenged te pegpalintutuu ney ki Hisus, su eyew egkakita ka umul rin kayi te lawa ney ne egpatey pad. 12 Purisu malehet iya ne egsalerep key layun te kamatayen, su eyew egpakaangken kew te umul ne ware egtamanan.

7 But we(excl), we(excl) are_ just _like a pot that was_made from dirt and had that expensive possession which is telling the Good Report stored in it, so_that the people would see that the very great power that is put in our(excl) weak body(s), is not our(excl) power, but rather, God's. 8 We(excl) suffer_difficulties by whatever means, but we(excl) are not just defeated. We(excl) are uncertain, but we(excl) don't just give_up. 9 We(excl) were persecuted, but we(excl) weren't abandoned by God; we(excl) were_given_ great _pain, but we(excl) weren't killed. 10 We(excl) were experiencing_(calamity) death like the death of Jesus, so_that the life that is given by Jesus can be seen in our(excl) body(s). 11 And while we(excl) are still alive, indeed we(excl) are always experiencing_(calamity) death due to our(excl) believing (in) Jesus, so_that his life can_be_seen here in our(excl) body(s) that still die. 12 Therefore it's correct indeed that we(excl) always experience_(calamity) death, so_that you(pl) will_be_able_to_receive life without ending.

13 [xr]Due nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Egpangguhud a su migpalintutuu e ma.” Ne iling ded degma due ka inggimu ney, migpangguhud key su migpalintutuu key ma. 14 Su nakanengneng key ne ka Manama ne mig-uyag te Magbebaye ne si Hisus, iyan ded degma eg-uyag kanami duma ki Hisus, wey eg-uyanen key nikandin duma kaniyu diye te tangkaan din. 15 In-antus ney sika se langun tenged kaniyu, su eyew egmasalig ka me etew ne egpakarawat te keyid-u te Manama wey egmasalig ka egpasalamat kandin, sikan naa ka egkasaye iya sikandin.

13 [xr]There's (something) written in the writings that goes, “I will_tell because I believe.” And what we(excl) do is_ just _like that, we(excl) tell because we(excl) believe. 14 Because we(excl) know that the God who brought_ the Lord Jesus _to_life, is the (one who) will_ also _bring_ us(excl) _to_life along_with Jesus, and we(excl) will_be_taken by him along_with you(pl) to his front. 15 We(excl) endured all that due to you(pl), so_that the people who can_receive the mercy of God will_increase and the (ones) thanking him will_increase, so then he will_ indeed _be_praised.

Ka peg-ugpe pinaahi te pegpalintutuu

Living by_means of believing/faith

16 Sika ka egpuunan ne ware key naawei te kabagget. Ne minsan ke egkapahan-ganaran e egmahuye seini se me lawa ney, piru inlig-en ded ka me gimukud ney tagse aldew. 17 Ka keyirapan ne in-antus ney, kene amana ne mabehat wey eglihad de sika, du te sika se dakel ne katelesan ne ware katamanan ne egkaangken ney keureme diye te langit. 18 Su kene ne iyan ney intengtengan sika se egkakita kayi te ampew te tane, ke kene, sika se kene egkakita ne diye te langit. Sika se egkakita, eglihad de, piru ka kene egkakita, ware mule katamanan.

16 That's the reason that we(excl) haven't been bereft of encouragement. And even if these bodies of ours(excl) are slowing getting_weak, but our(excl) souls are being_strengthened every day. 17 The difficulty(s) that we(excl) endured, are not overly heavy and they just pass_by, compared with that great splendor without ending that we(excl) will_receive in_the_future there in heaven/sky. 18 But it's not what can be seen here on top of the earth that we(excl) are looking at, but rather, that which can't be seen which is in heaven/sky. That which can be seen, just passes_by, but that which can't be seen, on_the_contrary has no ending.

Ka iyam ne lawa

The new body

51 Su nakanengneng ki ne emun ke egkahuhus e ka balungbalung ne in-ugpaan ta kayi te ampew te tane, ne iyan sika se lawa ta, duen ded egpeugpaan te Manama kanta diye te langit, sika se ware egtamanan ne lawa ne inggimu te Manama para kanta, ne kene ne hinimuwan te etew. 2 Kuntee, egkawangalan ki tenged su amana ki egkeupian ne egkabalbalawan e ka lawa ta, 3 su eyew ke igsaluub tad ka sika ne lawa ne diye te langit, kenad e egkakita ne migpalawas bes ka gimukud ta. 4 Su taheed te kayi ki pad kuntee mig-ugpe te seini ne lawa, egpakareg-uy ki pad iya te peg-antus ta. Piru kene ne iyan igpasabut due ne menu egkeupian kid e ne eg-awe te lawa ta kayi te ampew te tane, ke kene, egkeupian kid e ne egkasaluuban te lawa ne egpuun te langit, su eyew seini se lawa ne egpatey pad, egkaliwanan e te lawa ne kenad iya egpatey. 5 Ka Manama ka mig-andam kanta eyew egkarawat ta ka seini se iyam ne lawa, wey imbehayan ki nikandin te Panisingan isip palinneu ne egtumanen din iya sika.

51 Because we(incl) know that if the tent which we(incl) live in here on the top of the earth is demolished, which is our(incl) body, there_is a place_where_ God _will_cause_ us(incl) _to_live there in heaven/sky, (which is) that never ending body which God made for us(incl), that wasn't made by people. 2 Now/Today, we(incl) make_a_clamor because we(incl) greatly want our(incl) body(s) to become changed, 3 so_that if we(incl) put_on that body there in heaven/sky, it won't be seen that our(incl) soul(s) are naked. 4 Because now while we(incl) are still live in this body, we(incl) indeed wince in our(incl) suffering. But it's not meant by that that we(incl) want to get_out of our(incl) body(s) here on top of the earth, but rather, we(incl) want to dress_in a body from heaven/sky, so_that this body that still dies, can_be_replaced with a body that indeed doesn't die. 5 It is God who has prepared us(incl) so_that we(incl) can_receive this new body, and we(incl) have_been_given the Spirit by him as a sign that he will_ indeed _fulfill that.

6 Purisu ware ki migmahuye. Nakataha ki ne taheed te kayi ki pad te seini ne lawa, ware ki naan pad diye te Manama. 7 Su ka peg-ugpe ta kuntee pinaahi pad te pegpalintutuu, kene ne pinaahi ke nekey ka egkiteen ta. 8 Ware ki migmahuye minsan ke egkeupian kid e perem ne eg-engked te seini ne lawa wey eg-ugpe e duma te Magbebaye. 9 Su minsan ke kayi ki pad te ampew te tane wey ke diyad e te langit, egkeupian ki ne egpakapahale kandin. 10 [xr]Su keilangan ne eg-atubang ki langun diye ki Kristu eyew eggukuman nikandin. Ne ka tagse sabeka, egpakarawat te eleg kandin sumale te hinimuwan din kayi te ampew te tane, meupiya ma wey se mareet.

6 Therefore we(incl) haven't gotten_weak. We(incl) know that while we(incl) are still here in this body, we(incl) are not there with God. 7 Because our(incl) living now is by_means_of believing, not by_means_of what we(incl) see. 8 We(incl) haven't gotten_weak even though we(incl) wanted to leave_behind this body and live with the Lord. 9 Because even if we(incl) are still here on top of the earth or there in heaven/sky, we(incl) want to make_ him _happy. 10 [xr]Because we(incl) all need to face Christ to be judged by him. And each one, will_receive (what is) correct for him/her according to his/her acts here on top of the earth, good or bad.

Ka pegpeuliey te meupiya ne geyinawa

Returning to good love (LIT breath)

11 Purisu, tenged su due kaaldek ney te Magbebaye, impehes ney ka me etew ne egpalintutuu. Nakataha ka Manama ne malehet iya ka tuyu ney, wey eg-iman-iman key ne nakanengneng kew red degma due. 12 Ne kene ne inlalag ku seini ne menu egpeggasal key, ke kene, egbehayan ney re sikaniyu te puunan ne igpakapeggasal key nikaniyu, su eyew egpakatabak kew te seeye se iyan de igpeggasal ke nekey ka egkakita diye te etew, kene ne sika se diye te pusung din. 13 Emun ke due egkahi ne henduen key te egmambusawen, balahad de due, tenged su ka langun ne eggimuwen ney, para sika te Manama. Ne emun ke due man-e egkahi ne maheteng ka suman-suman ney, sikaniyu mismu, nakatahe e ne para kaniyu ka himu ney. 14 Su tenged te geyinawa ni Kristu kanami, warad e lein ne egkeyimu ney gawas te pegtuman kandin. Su nakataha key ne namatey si Kristu para te langun, sikan naa, nekeiling de te namatey e degma ka langun ne etew. 15 Iyan igpasabut due ne namatey sikandin para te langun ne etew eyew ka me etew ne neuyag pad, kenad e ne iyan pad eg-ikulen ka igkeupii ran, ke kene, sikan e se igkeupii te sika se namatey wey neuyag para kandan.

11 Therefore, because we(excl) have fear of the Lord, we(excl) persuade people to believe. God knows that our(excl) purpose is really true, and we(excl) hope that you(pl) also know that. 12 And I didn't say this for us(excl) to boast, but rather, we(excl) will_give you(pl) the reason that we(excl) can_be_boasted about by you(pl), so_that you(pl) can_answer those who just boast about what can_be_seen by people, not that in his/her heart. 13 If there's (someone who) says that it's as if we(excl) are crazy, just ignore that, because all that we(excl) do, is for God. And if there_is also (someone who) says that our(excl) thinking is sensible, you(pl) yourselves, already know that our(excl) work is for you(pl). 14 Because of the love of Christ for us(excl), we(excl) don't do anything else except obeying him. Because we(excl) know that Christ died for all, so then, it's like all people are also already dead. 15 What that means is that he died for all people so_that the people who are still alive, won't follow their desire(s), but rather, the desire(s) of that (one) who died and came_to_life for them.

16 Purisu, puun kuntee, kene key e eg-ugsi-ugsi te duma ne etew iling te inggimu te kene egpalintutuu te Manama. Dengan, iling due ka peg-ugsi-ugsi ney ki Kristu, piru kenad e ne iling due kuntee. 17 Purisu, ka minsan hentew ne nasabeke e diye ki Kristu, imbalbalawan e sikandin te Manama. Naawe e ka tapey ne pegkeetew rin, wey miggingume e ka iyam. 18 Ka Manama ka miggimu te seini se langun, wey sikandin ka impeg-uli te meupiya ne geyinawa ta diye te kandin pinaahi ki Kristu. Imbehayan key te Manama te himu te peg-uli te meupiya ne geyinawa te me etew diye te kandin. 19 Iyan ney igpasabut, ne egpeg-ulien te Manama ka meupiya ne geyinawa te langun ne etew diye te kandin pinaahi ki Kristu, wey kene din e egsumsumanen ka sale dan. Sika ka insalig te Manama kanami ne guhuren ne igpepangguhud.

16 Therefore, from now on, we(excl) don't investigate other people like is done by (those who) don't believe (in) God. Before, our(excl) investigation of Christ was like that, but it's not like that now. 17 Therefore, whoever is united in/with Christ, he/she is changed by God. His/Her old person is removed, and the new has come already. 18 It is God who made all this, and he restored our(incl) good love/breath to him by_means_of Christ. We(excl) have_been_given by God the work of restoring the good love/breath of the people to him. 19 What we(excl) mean is, that God will_restore the good love/breath between all the people and him by_means_of Christ, and he won't think_about/remember their sin(s). That's the story that God entrusted to us(excl) to tell.

20 Purisu, sikanami ka impeuyan ni Kristu, wey nekeiling de te egpakiglalag mismu ka Manama pinaahi kanami. Ne egbanasal key kaniyu isip ki Kristu ne pegbanasal ne peg-ulia niyu ka meupiya ne geyinawa niyu te Manama. 21 Ware sale ni Kristu, piru sikandin ka impeparusaan te Manama tenged te me sale ta, su eyew pinaahi te pegsabeka ta ki Kristu, eg-isipen ki te Manama ne matareng.

20 Therefore, we(excl) are sent by Christ, and it's just as if God himself speaks by_means_of us(excl). And we(excl) encourage you(pl) as if it were Christ encouraging to restore(pl) your(pl) good love/breath with God. 21 Christ had no sin, but he was_punished by God due to our(incl) sins, so_that by_means_of our(incl) uniting in/with Christ, we(incl) are_considered by God as righteous.

61 Ne puun su talagbulig key te Manama, egbanasalan ney sikaniyu ne kene niyu batasana ne hendue te ware karuan ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama ne narawat niyu. 2 [xr]Su migkahi ka Manama,

61 And because we(excl) are helper(s) of God, we(excl) encourage you(pl) that you(pl) don't make_it_your_custom that it's as if there's_no value of the goodness and mercy of God that you(pl) received. 2 [xr]Because God said,

wey imbulihan ku sikeykew te aldew te kaluwasan.”

3 Ware key miggimu te egpakasaligkat te duma, su eyew ware igkarew-ey te himu ne imbehey kanami. 4 Ke kene, pinaahi te langun ne eggimuwen ney, impakita ney ne suluhuanen key iya te Manama tenged te amana ne peg-antus ney te kasakit, keyirapan, wey me kalised. 5 [xr]Inlelampesan key, imprisu key, insesamuk key te mangune-kune, subla-subla ka peggimu ney, kulang ka peglipereng ney, wey egmanggutasan key. 6 Impakita ney man-e ne suluhuanen key iya te Manama pinaahi te malinis ne peg-ugpe ney, te katuenan ney, te pegpariralem ney, te keupiya ney diye te duma, te keyid-u ne imbehey te Panisingan te Manama, te malehet ne geyinawa, 7 te pegwali ney te kamalehetan, wey te geem te Manama ne impapitew rin pinaahi kanami. Imbehayan key man-e te Manama te pegkamatareng isip panganiban ne egpekeiling te sundang wey kalasag ney. 8 Isip suluhuanen te Manama, sengekakuwa ne egdayanen key te me etew wey sengekakuwa ne eglemetan key. Sengekakuwa ne eglalahan key te mareet, wey sengekakuwa ne meupiya ka iglalag kanami. Due egkahi ne me ubaten key minsan malehet ka eglalahen ney. 9 Kahiyen ne ware key kun neileyi, piru neilaan key red te duma. Egkengammatey key kun e, piru mannekal key pad. Minsan ke egpanlampesan key, piru ware key red himatayi. 10 Minsan ke due me kalaggew ney, piru egkahale key red. Minsan ke egkaayu-ayu key, piru masalig ka imparatu ney. Minsan ke hendue te ware karatuan ney, piru due langun kayi te kanami.

3 We(excl) didn't do (anything) that could_trip other(s), so_that nothing about the work that was_given to us(excl) could be scolded_about. 4 If not, by_means_of all of our(excl) actions, we(excl) have shown that we(excl) are really servant(s) of God due to our(excl) great enduring of pain, difficulty, and hardships. 5 [xr]We(excl) were beaten, we(excl) were imprisoned, we(excl) were severely disturbed_by_commotion, our(excl) work was strenuous, our(excl) sleeping was lacking, and we(excl) were hungry(pl). 6 We(excl) showed again that we(excl) are indeed servant(s) of God by_means_of our(excl) clean living, our(excl) skill(s)/knowledge, our(excl) humility, our(excl) goodness to other(s), the mercy given by the Spirit of God, true love, 7 our(excl) preaching the truth, and the power of God that he showed by_means_of us(excl). We(excl) were_ also _given righteousness by God as a weapon that's like our(excl) sword and shield. 8 As servant(s) of God, sometimes we(excl) are praised by the people and sometimes we(excl) are mocked. Sometimes we(excl) are spoken to with evil, so sometimes it's good what_is_spoken to us(excl). Some say that we(excl) (are) liars even though what_ we(excl) _say is true. 9 It's said that we(excl) aren't known, but we(excl) are known by other(s). We(excl) will_die(pl) [reportedly], but we(excl) are still strong/alive. Even if we(excl) are beaten(pl), we(excl) still haven't been_killed. 10 Even if we(excl) have sorrows, still we(excl) are always happy. Even if we(excl) are poor, we(excl) still have caused_ many _to_be_rich. Even though it's as if we(excl) have_no riches, rather we(excl) have everything.

11 Pinalangge ne matig-Kurintu, ware heles te peglalag ney kaniyu, wey amana ney geyinawei sikaniyu. 12 Kene ne kulang ka peggeyinawa ney kaniyu, ke kene, sikaniyu ka kulang ka peggeyinawa kanami. 13 Purisu, egpakiglalag a kuntee kaniyu iling te malehet ne me anak ku. Ne keilangan ne eggeyinawaan key nikaniyu iling te peggeyinawa ney kaniyu.

11 Beloved Corinthians, there's_nothing hidden in our(excl) speaking to you(pl), and we(excl) love you(pl) very_much. 12 Our(excl) love for you(pl) is not lacking, but rather, you(pl) are lacking in loving us(excl). 13 Therefore, I now speak to you(pl) like my own children. And it's_necessary that we(excl) are loved by you(pl) like our(excl) loving you(pl).

14 Kene kew sabeka te seeye se kene egpalintutuu. Su kene iya egkaayun ne egkasabeka ka matareng wey ka mareet se pegbebatasan, wey kene egkaayun ne egpekegduma ka malayag te marusilem. 15 Si Kristu wey si Meibulan, kene iya egkaayun ne egpekeg-uyun, ne iling naan ded degma ka migpalintutuu te seeye se kene egpalintutuu. 16 [xra][xrb]Kene iya egkaayun ne egpekeg-uyun ka diyus-diyus te sika se ugpaan te Manama. The defence of Paul concerning his authority

101 Sikeddiey si Pablu, ka egkekahiyen ne liyasen ke due te tangkaan niyu, piru wey kun de mabulut ke diye te mariyu. Ne kuntee, pinaahi te pegpariralem wey keyid-u ni Kristu, 2 egbanasalan ku sikaniyu ne emun ke duen a te kaniyu, kene perem ne keilangan ne egmabulut a te seeye se migbayung ne kalibutanen kun ka pegbebatasan ney wey ka katuyuan ney. 3 Su minsan ke etew key re, piru kene key egpakig-ehet te etew-etew re ne paahi. 4 Su ka me panganiban ne eggamiten ney te egpakig-ehet, kene ne panganiban kayi te ampew te tane, ke kene, sika se maresen ne panganiban te Manama ne egpakarereet te seeye se egsupak kandin. Egdereetan ney ka kene ne malehet ne pegpangatarengan te me etew, 5 wey ka igpeggasal ran ne egpakabalabag te peg-ila ran te Manama eyew egkabalbalawan ka suman-suman dan sumale te igkeupii ni Kristu. 6 Ne emun ke egkapamalehetan ney e ne eleg en iya ka pegtuman niyu ki Kristu, egparusaan ney e seeye se ware migtuman.

101 I am Paul, the one called cowardly when in front of you(pl), but only [reportedly] bold when away at a distance. And now/today, by_means_of the humility and mercy of Christ, 2 I urge you(pl) that if/when I am at your(pl) (place), I won't need to be fierce to those who accused that our(excl) customs and our(excl) purpose are worldly. 3 Because even though we(excl) are just people, we(excl) don't fight in a human way. 4 Because the weapons that we(excl) use to fight (with), (are) not the weapon(s) here on top of the earth, but rather, those strong weapon(s) of God that can_destroy those who disobey him. We(excl) will_destroy the reasoning/arguing of the people that is not true, 5 and what_ they _boast_about that blocks their knowing God so_that their thinking can_be_changed according to the desire of Christ. 6 And if/when we(excl) can witness that your(pl) obeying Christ is indeed true, we(excl) will_punish those who didn't obey.

7 Ka seyyup niyu su iyan niyu re egtengtengan ke nekey ka egkakita niyu. Ke duen ma amana eg-angken ne sakup e sikandin ni Kristu, keilangan ne eg-isipen din ne sakup key e degma ni Kristu iling kandin. 8 Su minsan ke subla ka pegpeggasal ku meyitenged te katenged ney, piru kena a egkeyilew, su ka Magbebaye ka migbehey kanami due eyew te peglig-en kaniyu, ne kene ne pegdereet kaniyu. 9 Kene niyu sumsumana ne egginaalreken ku sikaniyu te me sulat ku. 10 Su due egkahi ne wey e kun de mabulut wey egpehes ke diye te me sulat ku, piru mahuye e kun ke duen a, wey ware kun karuan te egmanlalahen ku. 11 Keilangan ne egkanengnengan te sika ne me etew, ne seeye se insulat ney te timpu ne ware key due, eggimuwen ney iya ke duen key.

7 Your(pl) mistake was because what_ you(pl) _looked_at was just what you(pl) can_see. If there_is (someone) who greatly accepts that he/she is a follower of Christ, he/she needs to think that we(excl) are also followers like him/her. 8 Because even if my boasting is excessive about our(excl) authority, nevertheless I am_ not _ashamed, because the Lord gives us(excl) that in_order for strengthening you(pl), and not (for) destroying you(pl). 9 Don't(pl) think that I am frightening you(pl) with my letters. 10 Because there are (some) who say that I am only fierce and persuade in my letters, but I am weak [reportedly] if I (am) there, and there's_no purpose [reportedly] to all_ I _say. 11 It's_necessary for those people to know, that those (things) that we(excl) wrote at the time that we(excl) weren't there, we(excl) will_ indeed _do (them) when we(excl) are there.

12 Kene key egpaalag-alag eggukum wey egpeg-iling te pegkeetew ney te seeye se me etew ne migpeggasal te pegkeetew ran wey kene key degma eggukum kandan. Su hendue te kulang ka katuenan dan! Miggimu sikandan te kandan mismu ne sekeranan eyew te pegseked wey peggukum te pegkeetew ran. 13 Piru sikanami mule, kene key egpasubla egpeggasal, su iyan ney re mule igpeggasal ka himu ne impeyimu te Manama kanami, ne nalagkes en iya kayi ka himu ney due te kaniyu. 14 Kene key degma egpasubla egpeggasal kaniyu meyitenged te himu ney due te kaniyu, tenged su sikanami ka an-anayan ne nekeendue te kaniyu ne migwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Kristu. 15 Kene key degma egpasubla egpeggasal te himu ne neyimu te duma ne etew. Piru egpallateng key ne egtulin pad ka pegpalintutuu niyu wey egkatimulan pad degma ka himu ney due te kaniyu ne imbehey te Manama. 16 Pegkapenga due te kaniyu, egpakawali key e te Meupiya ne Panugtulen diye te duma ne me inged ne mariyu kaniyu. Kene key egkeupian ne iyan ney igpeggasal ka himu te duma ne etew diye te me inged ne imbehey te Manama kandan.

12 We(excl) don't dare to compare_ our(excl) selves _with and judge those people who boast about their selves. Because it's_like their knowledge/skill is lacking! They made their own measuring_rod for measuring and judging their selves. 13 But we(excl) on_the_contrary, we(excl) won't boast excessively, because what we(excl) will_ just _boast_about is what_ God _has_caused_ us(excl) _to_do, and that includes the work there with you(pl). 14 We(excl) also don't boast excessively to you(pl) about our(excl) work there with you(pl), because we(excl) were the first who went_there to you(pl) and preached the Good Report about Christ. 15 We(excl) also don't boast excessively about the work done by other people. But we(excl) hope that your(pl) believing will_grow and that our(excl) work there with you(pl) that God gave will_ still _be_added_to. 16 When (we) finish there with you(pl), we(excl) will_be_able_to_preach the Good Report in other places far from you(pl). We(excl) don't want that what_ we(excl) _boast_about is the work of other people there in places that God gave to them.

17 [xr]Piru sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan, “Ke due egpeggasal, keilangan ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka igpeggasal rin.” 18 Su kene igkahale te Magbebaye ka etew ne egdayan te kandin mismu ne pegkeetew, ke kene, sika se etew ne egdayanen din.

17 [xr]But according to what_is_written in the Writings, “If someone boasts, it needs to be the Lord God that he/she boasts_about.” 18 Because the person who praises his/her own self doesn't please the Lord, but rather, that person who is praised by him.

Si Pablu wey ka kene ne malehet ne me apustulis

Paul and the false apostles

111 Kene kew pa ubag kapeleyi keddiey minsan ke henduen a te ungel. Antusa niyu pa! 2 Egpangalikud a kaniyu iling te pegpangalikud te Manama kaniyu. Nekeiling kew te sabeka ne mengebay ne ware pad neyilabeti ne intahahe kud ne igpaasawa te sabeka ne lukes ne iyan si Kristu. 3 [xr]Piru egkaaldek a su kema ke egkalimbungan kew, iling ki Iba te inlimbungan te uled, wey egkaawe e ka mapahetpet wey malehet ne geyinawa niyu ki Kristu. 4 Su egdawat kew te minsan hentew ne egmangendue te kaniyu ne egwali te lein ne Hisus, kene ne iling te inwali ney. Egdawat kew man-e te panisingan ne lein te narawat niyud e. Ne egdawat kew man-e te Meupiya kun ne Panugtulen ne kene ne iling te narawat niyud e. Mahaan kew re egkeuyan!

111 Please don't(pl) become_tired_of me even if it's_like I (am) a fool. Suffer(pl) it still! 2 I am jealous of you(pl) like God's being_jealous of you(pl). You(pl) are_like a single_girl who hasn't been_touched that I prepared to marry to a man that's Christ. 3 [xr]But I am afraid because what if you(pl) are cheated, like Eve (MS Iba) who was cheated by the snake, and your(pl) active and true love for Christ is removed. 4 Because you(pl) accept whoever goes_there to your(pl)_(place) and preaches a different Hisus, not like what_ we(excl) _preached. You(pl) also accept a spirit that's different from what you(pl) already accepted. And you(pl) also accept a so-called Good Report that's not like what you(pl) already accepted. 5 Migpalintutuu a ne kena a egkeengkeran te seeye se egkahi ne labew kun sikandan ne me apustulis. 6 Minsan pad ke kena a egkateu ne eglalag-lalag, piru kene ne kulang ka katuenan ku. Impapitew ney seini due te kaniyu te minsan nekey ne paahi.

5 I believe that I am not left_behind/inferior to those who say they (are) the high [reportedly] apostles. 6 Even if I am not skilled in speaking, yet my knowledge/skill is not lacking. We(excl) showed this to you(pl) by various way(s).

7 Nakasale e naa te pegpariralem ku te pegkeetew ku tenged te pegwali ku te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne ware migpabayad su eyew re egkatahud kew? 8 Taheed te miggimu a due te kaniyu, imbulihan a te lein ne punduk te migmalintutuu. Ne hendue te intakawan ku sikandan su migdawat e ma te keuyahan ku ne egpuun kandan eyew egpakabulig a kaniyu. 9 [xr]Su minsan ware egkeyimu ku te duen e pad te kaniyu, wara a migbuyu te minsan hentew kaniyu. Wara ad iya migpabulig kaniyu, wey minsan keureme, kene ku eggimuwen sika. 10 Ware egpakapeengked keddiey te pegpeggasal ku meyitenged due, tenged su kena a iya egpabulig kaniyu wey te minsan hentew diye te Akaya. Malehet seini se eglalahen ku iling kalehet te eglalahen ni Kristu. 11 Mani buwa te wara a migpabulig kaniyu? Puun buwa su ware ku geyinawei sikaniyu? Nakataha ka Manama ne inggeyinawaan ku iya sikaniyu!

7 Did I sin in my humbling my self by my preaching the Good Report and not requesting_payment so_that you(pl) could_ just _be_respected? 8 While I worked there at your(pl)_(place), I was_helped by a different group of believers. And it's_like I stole from them because I accepted my living from them so_that I could_help you(pl). 9 [xr]Because even if I couldn't work (for my living) while I was still with you(pl), I didn't beg from any of you(pl). 12 Egpabulus a ne kene egbuyu te tabang kaniyu su eyew egkasanggel e seeye se egpapitew-pitew re ne me apustulis ne egpeggasal ne nekeg-iling kun de ka himu ran te kanami. 13 Su ka seeye ne me etew, kene ne malehet ne me apustulis, ke kene, talaglimbung de sikandan wey egpapitew-pitew re ne me apustulis kun ni Kristu. 14 Ne kene ne kein-inuwan sika, su minsan si Meibulan, egpakapeiling sikandin te masil-ew ne panalihan te Manama. 15 Sikan naa, kene degma ne kein-inuwan ke egpakapeiling ka me suluhuanen din te me suluhuanen te matareng ne Manama. Ka pegpeggasal ni Pablu meyitenged te peg-antus din

The boasting of Paul about his suffering

16 Egliberen ku te egkahi, keilangan ne ware sabeka ne egsuman-suman ne ungel a. Piru ke iling ma rue ka suman-suman niyu keddi, antuse e pa nikaniyu te egpammineg su egpeggasal e pad ubag te minsan deisek de. 17 Seini se pegpeggasal ku, kene ne diye egpuun te Magbebaye, ke kene, inggimu ku re seini isip egkeungel. 18 Ne puun su masalig due te kaniyu ka egpeggasal iling te eggimuwen te me etew kayi te kalibutan, egpeggasal ad e degma. 19 Ew matagseb kew bes iya su egkahale kew re iya ne eg-antus te me ungel! 20 Eg-antus kew re iya ne eg-uripenen nikandan, egkuen ka langun ne kaniyu, eglimbungan, egpabekalan te pakpak dan, wey egtagpien nikandan. 21 Egkeyilew a ne eg-angken ne egliyasen key ne eggimu te iling due! Piru ke duen ma egpaalag-alag egpeggasal te minsan nekey—egpeggasal a degma minsan ke egpekeiling te ungel ka peglalag-lalag ku. 22 Egpeggasal sikandan ne Hibruwanen? Ti, iling e red degma. Egpeggasal sikandan ne kabuhalan ni Israil? Iling e red iya degma. Egpeggasal sikandan ne kabuhalan ni Abraham? Ti, iling e red iya man-e. 23 [xr]Me suluhuanen naa sikandan ni Kristu? Henduen a te egbusawen ka eglalag te iling kayi, piru meupiye e pad ne suluhuanen kuntere kandan! Subla pad ka keddiey ne peggimu, malasi e pad egkaprisu, kamasalig a lelampesi, wey kamasalig a perem namatey. 24 [xr]Kalalimma a lelampesi te karumaan ku ne me Hudiyu te tigtatelu ne pulu wey siyam (39) ne lampes. 25 [xra][xrb]Katatelu a lelampesi te matig-Ruma te tuked; kasabeka a bebatuwa, katatelu perem nalened ka barku ne in-unturan ku, wey due timpu ne nalened-lened a diye te dahat te senge-karusileman wey senge-kaaldew. 26 [xra][xrb]Te me hipanawan ku, masalig ka me karereetan ne egkabayaan ku: me baggiyu, me takawen, me karumaan ku ne me Hudiyu wey te kene ne me Hudiyu, diye te me siyudad, diye te inged ne ware mig-ugpe, diye te dahat, wey diye te me suled ta te pegpalintutuu ne kene bes ne malehet. 27 Mangune-kune ka peggimu ku taman te nabeley a, malasi ne kena a egpakalipereng, eggutasan a wey egkammaraan. Malasi ne ware egkakeen ku, wey egkaagsilan a tenged su kulang ka kumbale ku. 28 Ne timul pad due, tagse aldew, amana a egkabehati te keugpe te me punduk te migmalintutuu. 29 Ke due egmahuye, egkaheram ku degma ka kahuye din. Ne emun ke due neuyan te sale, egmangebel-ebel ka langet ku.

16 I say again, it's_necessary that no one thinks I am foolish. But if you(pl) thinking about me is like that, endure(pl) listening to me because I will_boast [embarrassedly] just a little. 17 This my boasting, is not from the Lord, but rather, I did it as foolishness. 18 And because many there at your(pl)_(place) boast like the people here in the world do, I will_boast also. 19 Oh you(pl) (are) wise indeed because you(pl) are happy to endure fools! 20 You(pl) endure being_enslaved by them, everything of yours(pl) is taken, (you) are cheated, they will_brag about (themselves) (LIT their wings will_be_flared), and (you) are slapped by them. 21 I am_ashamed to_accept that we(excl) are_scared to do like that! Ka impakita te Manama ki Pablu

What_ God _showed to Paul

121 Keilangan ne egpabulus a iya ka egpeggasal minsan ware egkaangey ku rue. Igpangguhud ku ke nekey ka impakita wey impataha te Manama keddiey. 2 Due etew ne neila ku[fn] ne migpalintutuu ki Kristu ne imbatun diye te igkatelu ne langit, me sapulu e wey hep-at (14) ne leg-un ka miglihad puun kuntee. Wara a nakataha ke imbatun naan iya ka lawa rin wey ke panisingan din de, ka Manama re ka nakanengneng. 3 Eg-abayan ku te egkahi, nekeila a ke hentew-a etawa sika, piru wara a nakataha ke nekey-a ka imbatun, lawa rin naa wey ke panisingan din de, ka Manama re ka nakanengneng. 4 Iyan ku re natahaan ne imbatun iya sikandin diye te ugpaan te Manama, ne taheed te diyad e sikandin, due narineg din ne kene egkaayunan te eglalag, wey ware degma ituhut ne igpepangguhud. 5 Purisu egpeggasal a meyitenged te sika ne etew, piru kena a egpeggasal meyitenged te pegkeetew ku, ke kene, sikan de se kahuye ku. 6 Piru, emun ke egkeupian a perem ne egpeggasal, di, kena a egkeyimu ne ungel su malehet ma ka igpangguhud ku. Piru ware ku himuwa sika, tenged su kena a egkeupian ne matikang ka pegtengteng niyu keddi du te sika se egkakita niyu wey egkarineg niyu ne eglalahen ku.

121 I really need to continue boasting even_though I can_get nothing by that. I will_tell what God showed (LIT caused_to_see) and revealed (LIT caused_to_know) to me. 2 There_is a person that I know[fn] who believed Christ who was lifted_up to the third heaven/sky, about fourteen (14) years back from now. I don't know if his/her body was really lifted_up or if it was just his/her spirit, only God knows. 3 I will_say again, I know who that person is, but I don't know what was lifed_up, his/her body or just his/her spirit, only God knows. 4 What I do know is that he/she was lifted_up to the living_place of God, and while he/she was there, he/she heard (something) that it's_ not _possible for a person to say, and it also can't be permitted to have told. 5 Therefore I will_boast about that person, but I won't boast about my self, instead, just my weakness(es). 6 But, if I wanted to boast [unactualized], then, I won't become a fool because what_ I _tell is correct/true. 7 Piru eyew kena a egpabekal te pakpak ku tenged te kein-inuwan ne nakita ku, imbehayan a te duhi ne inggamit ni Meibulan te pegbayad-bayad keddiey eyew kena a egpakapeggasal. 8 Katatelu a mighangyu te Manama ne eg-aween din e sika, 9 piru migkahiyan a nikandin, “Eleg e ka pegbulig ku keykew su egkakita ka geem ku due te kahuye nu.” Sikan naa ka amana a egkahale ne egpeggasal meyitenged te kahuye ku, su eyew ka geem ni Kristu, egweil kayi te keddiey. 10 Purisu, egkabennalan ad e te me kahuye ku, te peglemet keddi, te keyirapan ku, te pegbayad-bayad keddi, wey te kalised ku tenged ki Kristu. Ka pegkasasew ni Pablu te matig-Kurintu

The concerned of Paul for the (ones) from_Kurintu

11 Impehes a nikaniyu ne egpeggasal iling te egkeungel-ungel. Su kene ne iyan eg-uyag te iney wey amey ka me anak, ke kene, ka iney wey amey ka eg-uyag te me anak dan. 15 Egkahala a ke igpakabehey ku ka karatuan ku wey ka kanekal ku eyew te pegbulig kaniyu. Because it's not the children that provide_for the mother and father, but rather, the mother and father that provide_for their children. 15 I am happy if I can_give my wealth and my strength for helping you(pl). But even if I love you(pl) greatly, (I) wonder why your(pl) love for me is just small?

16 Due duma ne eg-uyun ne wara a neyimu ne mabehat due te kaniyu. Piru due migkahi ne maalistu e kun wey miglimbungan ku kun sikaniyu. 17 Piru te nekey ne paahi? Inlupihan kew te seeye se impeuyan ney due te kaniyu? 18 Imbanasalan ku si Titu ne eggendiye te kaniyu, wey imparumaan ku sikandin te suled ta te pegpalintutuu. Ne kene kew egpakakahi ne inleig-leig kew nikandin, wey ke ware nekeg-iling ka himu ney wey ka katuyuan ney.

16 There are some who agree that I didn't do (anything) heavy to you(pl). But there are (some) who say that I am cunning and that I [reportedly] cheated you(pl). 17 But by what means? Were you(pl) taken_advantage_of by those we(excl) sent to you(pl)? 18 I urged Titus (MS Titu) to go_there to you(pl), and I sent_with him our(incl) friend/cousin in believing. And you(pl) can't say that you(pl) were treated_badly by him, or that our(excl) work(s) and our(excl) purpose(s) (are) not the same.

19 Kahiyen niyu buwa ne iyan ney iglalag te iling due ne menu egpangatarengan key? Kene ne iling due! Me pinalangge, sikanami se nasabeka due ki Kristu, eglalahan ney sikaniyu kayi te tangkaan te Manama ne ware lein ne tuyu ney, ke kene, ka peglig-en de iya kaniyu. 20 Egkaaldek a ne kema ke peggenduen ku, kene ku igkeupii ka eggimuwen niyu, wey kene niyu degma igkeupii ka keddiey ne eggimuwen. Egkaaldek a ne kema ke due egpeehetey, egpekeg-imma, egkabelu, egpalelehed, eg-iran-iran, egsesalupet, egpeggasal, wey due samuk. 21 Egkaaldek a man-e, su kema ke peglibed ku due te kaniyu, egpeyilawan a te Manama tenged kaniyu. Ne kema ke egpakasinehew a tenged su masalig ka nakasale dengan ne ware mig-inniyug te lilinditi ne hinimuwan dan, te pegpeyibhilabetey ran ne kene ne alunggun, wey te mekeyilew-hilew ne hinimuwan dan.

19 Maybe you(pl) thought that why we(excl) talk like that is for our(excl) defending of our(excl) selves? It's not like that! Beloved (ones), we(excl) who are_united in Christ, we(excl) tell you(pl) here in front of God that we(excl) have/had no other purpose, but only, just the strengthening of you(pl). 20 I am afraid if at my going_there, I don't like what_ you(pl) _will/are_doing, and if you(pl) also don't like what_ I _will/are_doing. I am afraid if there is/are (some) who argue/fight_with_each_other, envious_of_each_other, angry, greedy, insulting, gossiping, boasting, and (if) there_is a disturbance. 21 I am afraid again, because what if at my returning there to you(pl), I am embarrassed by God due to you(pl). And what if I cry because there are many who sinned before and (who) haven't turned_from their dirty deed(s), from immorality (LIT those who a not a couple meddling_with_each_other), and from other shameful actions.

Ka katammanan ne pegpanulu wey pegpangemusta

The final teaching and greetings

131 [xr]Seini ka igkatelu ne peggenduen ku te kaniyu. Ne sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan, “Ka minsan nekey ne sumbung, keilangan ne egkapamalehetan te daruwa wey ke tatelu naa ne talagpamalehet.” 2 Tapey kud e panpanayi sikaniyu te seeye se igkarangeb ne peggenduen ku. Ne kuntee, eg-abayan ku man-e te eglalag taheed te wara a due: kayi te peglibed ku man-e due, egparusaan ku iya seeye se nenakasale dengan, wey seeye degma se duma. 3 Eggimuwen ku seini su egkeupian kew ne egkapamalehetan ne diye iya egpuun te ki Kristu ka inlalag ku. Maresen sikandin wey kene ne mahuye ne egweil due te kaniyu. 4 Su minsan ke inlansang sikandin te krus tenged te kahuye din, piru neuyag sikandin tenged te geem te Manama. Ne sikanami degma, nakaheram key te kahuye tenged te pegsabeka ney kandin, piru tenged te geem te Manama, egkeuyag key duma kandin eyew egpakabulig kaniyu.

131 [xr]This is my third going_there to you(pl). And according to what_is_written in the Writings, “Whatever (kind) of charge/accusation, needs to be proven by two or three witnesses.” 2 I warned you(pl) before on my second going_there. And now, I will_repeat saying again while I am not there: here on my returning again there, I will_ indeed _punish those who sinned(pl) before, and also those others. 3 I will_do this because you(pl) want it to be proven that what_ I _say really comes from Christ. He is strong/powerful and not weak at moving among you(pl). 4 Because even though he was nailed on the cross due to his weakness, but he was_made_alive due to the power of God. And we(excl) also, we(excl) have felt/experienced weakness due to our(excl) uniting in him, but due to the power of God, we(excl) are made_alive along_with him in_order to be_able_to_help you(pl).

5 Ug-ugsiya niyu ka pegkeetew niyu eyew te pegtengteng ke malehet naan en iya ka pegpalintutuu niyu. Keilangan ne eg-el-elehan niyu ka pegkeetew niyu! Nakanengneng kew e ne duen e si Kristu te kaniyu, gawas de ke kene ne malehet ka pegpalintutuu niyu. 6 Eg-iman-iman a ne egkanengnengan niyu ne malehet a iya ne apustulis. 7 Eg-ampu key te Manama ne kene kew eggimu te mareet. Ne kene ne iyan ney ig-ampu te iling due ne menu egpapitew key ne migmalampusen ka himu ney due te kaniyu, ke kene, eyew egpekeyimu kew ke nekey ka eleg minsan ke henduen kun te kene key ne malehet ne apustulis. 8 Su kene key egpekeyimu te minsan nekey ne supak te kamalehetan, ke kene, sikan de iya se pegsawed te kamalehetan. 9 Su igkahale ney ke mahuye key ne manekal kew mule. Ne eg-ampu key ne egkabalbalawan ka pegbebatasan niyu eyew ware igkarew-ey. 10 Insulat ku seini te kene e pad egpekeendue, su eyew pegginguma ku due, kena ad ne mapahetpet ne eggamit te katenged ku ne imbehey te Magbebaye keddiey—katenged te peglig-en kaniyu, ne kene ne pegdereet kaniyu.

5 Investigate(pl) your(pl) selves for seeing if your(pl) believing is indeed true. You(pl) need to test your(pl) selves! You(pl) know that Christ is there in/with you(pl), unless your(pl) believing just isn't true. 6 I hope that you(pl) know that I am indeed a true apostle. 7 We(excl) pray to God that you(pl) won't do evil. And we(excl) don't pray like that to show that our(excl) work was successful there with you(pl), but rather, so_that you(pl) will_be_able_to_do what is correct even if we(excl) [reportedly] are_like not true apostle(s). 8 Because we(excl) can't do anything against the truth, but rather, just that that spreads/sows the truth. 9 Because we(excl) are happy if we(excl) are weak and you(pl) on_the_contrary are strong/alive. And we(excl) pray that you(pl) will_change your(pl) custom/behavior so_that there_will_be_nothing to_scold_ (you) _for. 10 I wrote this before I can go_there, so_that at my arrival there, I won't be overbearing in using my authority that the Lord gave to me—authority for strengthening you(pl), and not for destroying you(pl).

11 Te katammanan me suled, kahale kew. Ay-ayari niyu ka pegbebatasan niyu wey sahipaa niyu ka hangyu ku. Sabeka kew wey ugpe kew ne malinawen. Ne emun ke eggimuwen niyu sika, ka Manama ne egpuunan te geyinawa wey keupianan ka egduma kaniyu.

11 Finally friends/cousins, be happy(pl). Improve(pl) your(pl) behavior and pay_attention(pl) to my request. Be_united(pl) and live(pl) peacefully. And if/when you(pl) do that, God who is the source of love and goodness will_accompany you(pl).

12 Pegpangemusteey kew ka tagse sabeka te pegpapitew ne migpaheyinaweey kew.[fn]

12 Greet_[reciprocally](pl) each one showing that you(pl) love_one_another.[fn]

Ne ka langun ne keet-etawan te Manama, egpangemusta degma kaniyu.

And all the people of God, also greet you(pl).

13 Ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, ka geyinawa te Manama, wey ka pegsabeka niyu te Panisingan te Manama, egkaangken niyu langun.[fn]

13 (May) the goodness and mercy of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the uniting of the Spirit of God with you(pl), be received by you(pl) all.[fn]
